attachments.gap: No general attachment relation, legal attachment checks, equip or attachment SBAs.

copy_tokens.gap: Ordinary tokens and nonlegendary self-copy exist; arbitrary permanent copies, face/copy exceptions and stack spell/ability copies need shared characteristic/stack machinery.

private_zones.gap: Private scry/search exist; extend selectors, delegated/opponent choices, top-library casting visibility and arbitrary card-name choices without hidden-state leakage.

combat_turn_control.gap: Ordinary two-player combat exists. Add extra phase/turn queue, control-player decision authority, crew, history and effective-characteristic restrictions.
